author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Diagonal fish with a pointed nose in the top-right corner, forked tail at the lower left, and a large crossed-out eye; the current drawing's eye was a 4-unit X that rendered as a blob and its nose was a square corner.
omissions: The dorsal and pelvic fins are left out: as single strokes they read as legs, and there is no room for outlined flaps beside the plump body that the full-size X eye needs.
